That is further ahead than your workspace allows.

Your own devices keep these, encrypted. A message goes out when one of them is online at or after its time, so if all are off it waits for the first one back. This phone tries in the background, but Android may delay it.
Nothing scheduled. Use \"Send later\" behind the + in the composer.
Due: goes out as soon as one of your devices is online.
Its time passed long ago while your devices were off. It may be out of date, so it stays here until you decide.
Your workspace turned scheduling off. It stays here until you send or cancel it.
This device can\'t reach that conversation. You may have left it.

Cancel this message? Nobody will see it.
